blocks.text: MOSCOW — Russia’s emergencies ministry said on Monday that a “massive cyberattack” hit its application, designed to warn people of incoming drone attacks and other threats. The announcement came hours after Ukraine said it suspected its air raid alert system had been hacked, after false warnings of a radiation threat appeared on the app. The cyberattacks came after the longest truce of the Ukraine war, limited to the eastern Kherson region, ended.
